title: Constant module sheafification is exact
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and B a commutative ring. The constant module sheaf functor F from B-modules to modules over the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Consequently F(ker g) and F(coker g) are canonically isomorphic to ker(Fg) and coker(Fg) for every linear map g.

proof.text: Evaluate the constant module presheaf functor at an arbitrary object. This composite is naturally the identity functor on B-modules and thus preserves all limits and colimits. Limits and colimits of module presheaves are evaluated sectionwise; joint reflection by evaluations proves finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation by the constant presheaf functor.

Module sheafification is a left adjoint and preserves finite limits. Compose with the constant presheaf functor. The kernel and cokernel comparison isomorphisms for a functor preserving the corresponding finite limits and colimits give the stated consequence.
